name: Feasibility: Partner profile (Medailonek)
description:
Owner per PRD: Partnership team.

As-Is: all edits go via email to the partner manager, who manually enters them into WordPress. There are 3 separate WP instances for CZ/SK/HU.

h2. Scope in PRD

- Company information, public profile on the Partners website
- Profile editing (mandatory / optional fields)
- Approval / rejection of changes before publication — AI keyword check, no manual review
- Skill verification when a new qualification is added; requirements checklist per skill group
- Displayed ratings and feedback
- Partner commissions overview, partner program overview with link to tier detail
- My contracts (signed, unsigned, status), partner projects overview

h2. To analyse

- WordPress: retain as public frontend or replace (OQ-20) — this decision blocks the architecture
- Scope and approach to data migration from the 3 WP instances (OQ-04) — data quality audit
- Publishing path: portal → public profile. Write API into WP, or new frontend?
- AI keyword check — feasibility, tooling, false-positive handling
- Where profile master data lives and how it syncs

h2. Output

Systems involved, integration gaps, T-shirt size, blockers, MVP / later / out-of-scope recommendation.
